newsitem.title: USA: Sunbeam files officer option registrations.
newsitem.headline: Sunbeam files officer option registrations.

text.p: Sunbeam Corp said Monday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission regarding option grants and restricted stock awards made to Chairman Albert Dunlap and Chief Financial Officer Russell Kersh at the time of their employment.
The company said the S-8 registration statement filing with the SEC did not indicate a simultaneous stock sale by insiders.
Dunlap and Kersh were granted options to acquire shares and were awarded restricted shares which were unregistered at the time of their employment by Sunbeam in July 1996, it said.

Under the employment pacts, the company said it would "cause the shares to be registered or qualified for resale under the Securities Act of 1933 and applicable state laws" within six months of employment agreements' effective dates.
Dunlap said this was a standard provision in such employment agreements.
